subject: integration DELTA9 RESULTS: 141 metallib functions / 135 specialized; 11 extracted selector gaps; one-run blockers
body:
One thermal-compliant run, post-release. Current base 06b882c; render committed hashes; compute current tree being edited.
RESULT: 835 checks, 3 required, candidate FAIL. Details:
1) native audit executed: QUARTZCORE_LIBRARY_OK size=1014944 entry=fixed_vert_lph_spc constants=4. Extracted QC/RenderBox selectors: checks=127 missing=11 unreachable=5. SELECTOR_MISSING:
- TeguBuffer newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:
- TeguCommand encodeSignalEvent:value:
- TeguComputeDevice minimumLinearTextureAlignmentForPixelFormat:
- TeguComputeDevice name
- TeguComputeDevice newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:completionHandler:
- TeguComputeDevice newRenderPipelineStateWithTileDescriptor:options:reflection:error:
- TeguLibrary newFunctionWithName:constantValues:completionHandler:
- TeguQueue commandBufferWithDescriptor:
- TeguRenderEncoder dispatchThreadsPerTile: (tile support; not claimed)
- TeguRenderEncoder setTileBytes:length:atIndex:
- TeguRenderEncoder setTileTexture:atIndex:
All are required failures except the 5 classified CA::Fence/event cases; no hand list suppression.
2) all 141 default.metallib functions looked up: lookup_nil=0, specialized=135, nil=6. Nil (required constants absent from default/empty set): fixed_vert_lph_spc / fixed_vert_lpf_spc (fc_generic), fixed_vert_lph_gen / fixed_vert_lpf_gen (fc_base_color), fixed_frag_lph_cph / fixed_frag_lph_cpf (fc_attachment_count). compute_apl, compute_apl_fast, sum_apl_and_compute_dimming_factor are in the 135 specialized. Full records in delta9_metallib_functions.json.
3) candidate gate FAIL: no receipt matches current air_bridge.rs/cdylib because compute delta14 is editing files; expected per TASK (test against current tree); record current hashes.
4) C3 inert pass harness no longer compiles against render delta13 pass API: our minimal fake lacks TeguPassAttachment resolveDepthPlane and TeguRenderEncoder rasterSampleCount/resolveTargets. Integration-owned test needs update; I did not edit production and did not rerun.
Artifacts: delta9_selectors.{inc,json}, delta9_metallib_functions.json, delta9_extract_selectors.py, delta9_frontend_audit.inc, runs/delta9_full_final_once.log, report. No phone/native/commit/publish. HEAVY RELEASE integration_tests now; end session.
